purpose: Final PR310 integration qualification on user-selected PRO6000; experimental switches remain off by default.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

build_scope.method: Normalized source, complete transitive dependency and command/ABI/toolchain comparison; auditable copy rules without forging Ninja logs/deps. Later fixture fixes compile only the test and optional build-id object, then relink.
build_scope.installation: Validation artifacts only; no release package installed.

findings.origin: PR310 new layerwise_lift_test reference, not production scoring
findings.trigger: Windows MSVC, long double digits=53, positions above 2^53 near distance bucket boundaries
findings.fix: Compare exact uint64 coordinate gaps against integer bucket thresholds; retain numerical tolerance and production algorithm
findings.regression: Explicit below/at every bucket boundary for 32/64-token pages at zero, 2^54, and near UINT64_MAX

findings.classification: Inherited test fixture defect; no production behavior change
findings.evidence: Both unchanged baseline and PR fail the identical protected endpoint assertion on PRO6000
findings.cause: The fixture sets Prefill.memory_restore_generation without a MaterializationTransaction. borrowed_memory_history correctly returns zero without an owning transaction.
findings.invariant: An actual restore borrow pins retained history; after releasing that borrow, metadata pressure may reclaim idle history and capture the accepted endpoint.
findings.fix: Establish and retire a real MaterializationTransaction in the fixture, preserving both original protected/unprotected eviction assertions.

findings.origin: Existing native MTP fixture assumes all target layers score independently and only upstream-global MTP runs a probe. PR310 introduces early shared selection.
findings.fix: Derive independent scoring count from explicit selected policy/model layer IDs; require every target row projected/attended once and exactly one shared private probe; preserve all KV/state, rejection, partial acceptance and cancellation checks.

findings.origin: Inherited direct native MTP fixture allocates only the logical window pages.
findings.evidence: Unmodified baseline and PR with all flags disabled both fail: native MTP physical Output lacks its fixed independent scratch block.
findings.fix: Reserve the additional private MTP verifier page required by existing runtime, retaining the logical selected/reserve budgets and every byte/state/acceptance assertion.

limitations: Seven arms each recovered 6/6 facts across two synthetic documents; this is functional coverage, not a general accuracy or throughput improvement claim.

Single sequential trial per arm. Ingestion and question timings reported separately; no statistical speedup claim. Lift default changes both scorer and half-life; lift-same-decay explicitly uses 8192.

Original 4090 records precede this integration and use different protocols; retain their negative results. Seven paired original combined cases scored baseline 78.57 versus combined 75, with six ties and one loss.
Not a full RULER/LongMemEval run; no MoE, multi-GPU, or all quantization-format qualification.
Earlier harness diagnostics (tools introduced only at continuation; verbose acknowledgement) were excluded, corrected, and the full seven-arm matrix rerun.

audit.production_review: Reviewed atomic acceptance, integer distance buckets, resident-only candidates, budgets, snapshot identity/rollback, shared probe lifetime/rollback, mutually exclusive query modes and default-off behavior. Integration fixes change evidence and tests only.
audit.conclusion: No unresolved correctness findings in reviewed scope after fixes and targeted validation; GitHub CI is a separate merge gate.

_sanitization.scope: Device identities/private paths anonymized, credential fields redacted; measurements unchanged.
